  "practices": [
    {"id": "prac-01-metadata", "text": "Provide metadata for both human users and computer applications.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Provide metadata for both human users and computer applications.", "location": "8.2"},
    {"id": "prac-02-descriptive", "text": "Provide metadata that describes the overall features of datasets and distributions.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Provide metadata that describes the overall features of datasets and distributions.", "location": "8.2"},
    {"id": "prac-03-structural", "text": "Provide metadata that describes the schema and internal structure of a distribution.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Provide metadata that describes the schema and internal structure of a distribution.", "location": "8.2"},
    {"id": "prac-04-license", "text": "Provide a link to or copy of the license agreement that controls use of the data.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Provide a link to or copy of the license agreement that controls use of the data.", "location": "8.3"},
    {"id": "prac-05-provenance", "text": "Provide complete information about the origins of the data and any changes you have made.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Provide complete information about the origins of the data and any changes you have made.", "location": "8.4"},
    {"id": "prac-06-quality", "text": "Provide information about data quality and fitness for particular purposes.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Provide information about data quality and fitness for particular purposes.", "location": "8.5"},
    {"id": "prac-07-version-indicator", "text": "Assign and indicate a version number or date for each dataset.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Assign and indicate a version number or date for each dataset.", "location": "8.6"},
    {"id": "prac-08-version-history", "text": "Provide a complete version history that explains the changes made in each version.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Provide a complete version history that explains the changes made in each version.", "location": "8.6"},
    {"id": "prac-09-persistent-uri-datasets", "text": "Identify each dataset by a carefully chosen, persistent URI.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Identify each dataset by a carefully chosen, persistent URI.", "location": "8.7"},
    {"id": "prac-10-persistent-uri-within", "text": "Reuse other people's URIs as identifiers within datasets where possible.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Reuse other people's URIs as identifiers within datasets where possible.", "location": "8.7"},
    {"id": "prac-11-uri-versions", "text": "Assign URIs to individual versions of datasets as well as to the overall series.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Assign URIs to individual versions of datasets as well as to the overall series.", "location": "8.7"},
    {"id": "prac-12-mr-format", "text": "Make data available in a machine-readable, standardized data format that is well suited to its intended or potential use.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Make data available in a machine-readable, standardized data format that is well suited to its intended or potential use.", "location": "8.8"},
    {"id": "prac-13-locale-neutral", "text": "Use locale-neutral data structures and values, or, where that is not possible, provide metadata about the locale used by data values.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Use locale-neutral data structures and values, or, where that is not possible, provide metadata about the locale used by data values.", "location": "8.8"},
    {"id": "prac-14-multiple-formats", "text": "Make data available in multiple formats when more than one format suits its intended or potential use.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Make data available in multiple formats when more than one format suits its intended or potential use.", "location": "8.8"},
    {"id": "prac-15-reuse-vocab", "text": "Use terms from shared vocabularies, preferably standardized ones, to encode data and metadata.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Use terms from shared vocabularies, preferably standardized ones, to encode data and metadata.", "location": "8.9"},
    {"id": "prac-16-formalization", "text": "Opt for a level of formal semantics that fits both data and the most likely applications.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Opt for a level of formal semantics that fits both data and the most likely applications.", "location": "8.9"},
    {"id": "prac-17-bulk", "text": "Enable consumers to retrieve the full dataset with a single request.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "bulk_file", "grounding_span": "Enable consumers to retrieve the full dataset with a single request.", "location": "8.10"},
    {"id": "prac-18-subsets", "text": "If your dataset is large, enable users and applications to readily work with useful subsets of your data.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "If your dataset is large, enable users and applications to readily work with useful subsets of your data.", "location": "8.10"},
    {"id": "prac-19-conneg", "text": "Use content negotiation in addition to file extensions for serving data available in multiple formats.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Use content negotiation in addition to file extensions for serving data available in multiple formats.", "location": "8.10"},
    {"id": "prac-20-realtime", "text": "When data is produced in real time, make it available on the Web in real time or near real-time.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "api", "grounding_span": "When data is produced in real time, make it available on the Web in real time or near real-time.", "location": "8.10"},
    {"id": "prac-21-up-to-date", "text": "Make data available in an up-to-date manner, and make the update frequency explicit.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Make data available in an up-to-date manner, and make the update frequency explicit.", "location": "8.10"},
    {"id": "prac-22-unavailable", "text": "For data that is not available, provide an explanation about how the data can be accessed and who can access it.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "advisory", "grounding_span": "For data that is not available, provide an explanation about how the data can be accessed and who can access it.", "location": "8.10"},
    {"id": "prac-23-api", "text": "Offer an API to serve data if you have the resources to do so.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "api", "grounding_span": "Offer an API to serve data if you have the resources to do so.", "location": "8.10.1"},
    {"id": "prac-24-web-standards", "text": "When designing APIs, use an architectural style that is founded on the technologies of the Web itself.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "api", "grounding_span": "When designing APIs, use an architectural style that is founded on the technologies of the Web itself.", "location": "8.10.1"},
    {"id": "prac-25-api-docs", "text": "Provide complete information on the Web about your API. Update documentation as you add features or make changes.", "location": "8.10.1"},
    {"id": "prac-26-avoid-breaking", "text": "Avoid changes to your API that break client code, and communicate any changes in your API to your developers when evolution happens.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "api", "grounding_span": "Avoid changes to your API that break client code, and communicate any changes in your API to your developers when evolution happens.", "location": "8.10.1"},
    {"id": "prac-27-preserve-id", "text": "When removing data from the Web, preserve the identifier and provide information about the archived resource.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "When removing data from the Web, preserve the identifier and provide information about the archived resource.", "location": "8.11"},
    {"id": "prac-28-assess-coverage", "text": "Assess the coverage of a dataset prior to its preservation.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Assess the coverage of a dataset prior to its preservation.", "location": "8.11"},
    {"id": "prac-29-gather-feedback", "text": "Provide a readily discoverable means for consumers to offer feedback.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "site", "grounding_span": "Provide a readily discoverable means for consumers to offer feedback.", "location": "8.12"},
    {"id": "prac-30-make-feedback-available", "text": "Make consumer feedback about datasets and distributions publicly available.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "site", "grounding_span": "Make consumer feedback about datasets and distributions publicly available.", "location": "8.12"},
    {"id": "prac-31-enrich", "text": "Enrich your data by generating new data when doing so will enhance its value.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Enrich your data by generating new data when doing so will enhance its value.", "location": "8.13"},
    {"id": "prac-32-complementary", "text": "Enrich data by presenting it in complementary, immediately informative ways, such as visualizations, tables, Web applications, or summaries.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "content", "grounding_span": "Enrich data by presenting it in complementary, immediately informative ways, such as visualizations, tables, Web applications, or summaries.", "location": "8.13"},
